finding_summary: Current Nanoda 0.4.16 retains public serde-default num_threads=0, but check_all_declars uses the parallel helper only above one thread. Zero therefore executes check_all_declars_serial and calls check_declar for every declaration before success reporting. The 29-item issue/PR inventory is complete within the request protocol and has no same-case report, but current source safety independently makes a new defect report inaccurate.
canonical_effect: No mutation registry, survivor inventory, mutation classification, modeled metric or scientific evidence changed. Derived current-state artifacts may refresh only their producing revision and queue/status projection.

recommendation.action: Do not create a Nanoda issue or regression proposal for the pinned mutant behavior; preserve the local evidence and reopen only on a source-bound trigger.
